blocks.text: SINGAPORE — Malacañang on Wednesday urged Batangas 1st District Rep. Leandro Leviste to face the case against him and post bail after a Makati court ordered his arrest for an alleged violation of the Public Service Act. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Leviste could present evidence and defend himself in court if he maintains that he did nothing wrong. “Kung meron naman po sapat na ebidensya si Congressman Leviste, maaari niya naman po itong labanan at ipagtanggol ang kanyang sarili,” Castro told reporters here.
